text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph! Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——30 sets, completed.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Chest expanders next, then. 
Keep focusing on the resistance, nice and 
slow.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
("10 Keys to Praise-Based Coaching," 
"Phrases to Inspire Motivation"...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I thought things like that 
were the "correct answer," but——

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Doesn't seem like the right fit, does it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Every relationship has its own way of 
being built, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Hah...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(The method that suits her... and me. 
In that case, the answer must be...——)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(That research paper published the other 
day... 
it could be useful for her...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (The book I read recently also had——)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Training regimens that fit her, running 
forms... 
and then nutritional snack recipes...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...That should do it.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Groove-senpai. May I ask you to look over 
my training again today? 
Even just two or three dashes would be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Very well. 
And also... this is for you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Eh? 
This is...——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Training materials...?!  
And this notebook is...——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Um, would it be all right if I tried 
the running form written here right now?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. 
...I will watch. I'll take your time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: —! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah——!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
———Ah... I felt incredible forward drive. 
To think adjusting my arm swing could do 
this much...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Here is your time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...! 
—My time improved!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(——That same smile. 
Just like those two back then.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (—It feels... strangely unfamiliar...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Senpai, may I try the training regimen 
you summarized on the next page as well?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Try whatever you wish. 
——I'll be watching.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I just need to offer her all the 
knowledge I possess. 
—Of that much, I am certain. ...Surely.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing senior and junior working hard 
together 
in sweet harmony warmed my heart.
